# LLM Model Mapping Configuration
# ===========================================
# Format: alias=litellm_model_identifier
#
# Use aliases in your code for easy model switching.
# Models prefixed with 'litellm/' are routed through LiteLLM.
# Models without prefix use OpenAI directly.
# ===========================================

# OpenAI Models (direct)
# -----------------------------

# Google Gemini Models (via LiteLLM)
# -----------------------------

# -----------------------------
